title: MSSQL XPCmdshell Suspicious Execution
description: Detects when the MSSQL "xp_cmdshell" stored procedure is used to execute commands
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

logsource.definition: Requirements: MSSQL audit policy to monitor for "xp_cmdshell" must be enabled in order to receive this event in the application log (Follow this tutorial https://dba.stackexchange.com/questions/103183/is-there-any-way-to-monitor-execution-of-xp-cmdshell-in-sql-server-2012)
